name: Hanging Leg Raise
variation: Straight-leg hanging raise from a fixed pull-up bar; no swing, bent-knee substitution, or back kick.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter, athlete facing left, both closed overhand grips visible; space left for horizontal legs.

muscles.note: Purple is a qualitative teaching hierarchy, not a measured activation map. Deep hip flexors are not drawn through the skin.

frames.label: Hang and brace
frames.cue: Hang with straight arms and brace to stop any swing.
frames.state: Legs together below hips, shoulders controlled, full closed overhand grips.

frames.label: Begin raise
frames.cue: Lift both straight legs forward slowly without kicking.
frames.state: Both straight legs partially raised between vertical and horizontal; generated pose is not a measured 45-degree position.

frames.label: Reach parallel
frames.cue: Raise your legs to hip height while keeping your torso steady.
frames.state: Both legs approximately horizontal, knees extended without forced lockout; no backward lean or swing.

frames.label: Hold control
frames.cue: Pause briefly with your abs braced and no swinging.
frames.state: Same peak configuration as frame 3; intentional hold.

frames.label: Lower slowly
frames.cue: Lower both legs together under control.
frames.state: Same middle configuration as frame 2 on the controlled descent.

frames.label: Return to hang
frames.cue: Finish below your hips without kicking your legs behind you.
frames.state: Same still hang as frame 1; loop boundary stationary.
